name: gabriel-operator
description: Design complete Persona model drafts with ontology, Data Feeds, Signals, playbooks and ROI.

interface.longDescription:
Build a domain-specific AI Persona model with connected ontology, Data Feeds, Signals, reviewed playbooks and evidence-backed ROI. The included skills help you turn the domain, source evidence, approval boundary and accepted outcome into coherent, reviewable model definitions.

This package authors local drafts. Activate the reviewed model through Gabriel Operator or separately authorized live tooling. Credentials, participant records and execution receipts remain in their runtime workspace.
defaultPrompt: Design a Persona with an ontology, Data Feeds, Signals, playbooks and ROI.
Draft the source-to-outcome loop for this Persona using its existing model files.
Review whether this Persona’s ROI calculator and outcome mappings use supported evidence.
